subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers close or supersede the open dirty fork PR, adopt and rebase it, or keep this issue blocked on that fork path?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but an open unmerged fork PR still references this issue with closing syntax, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Close or supersede the fork path
options.body: Close or supersede the dirty fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current `ui/src/pages/debug` files.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch and repair it against the current route-owned Debug page/view structure before review.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on the existing fork PR and accept that no new ClawSweeper fix should be queued meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Close or supersede the fork path
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the dirty fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current `ui/src/pages/debug` files.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original Debug dashboard surface and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether to supersede or adopt the fork path.
